alert_type: While officially registered to the Russian emergency services (MChS), this aircraft has been tracked flying between Russian military bases and conflict zones, potentially transporting Wagner Group mercenaries and supplies.
alert_content: The Ministry of Emergency Situations is ostensibly a civilian agency responsible for disaster relief and emergency response. However, some of its aircraft, including RA-76845, have been documented engaging in activities that appear to support Russian military and paramilitary operations abroad.
owner_info: The Ministry of Civil Defence, Emergencies and Disaster Relief is a Russian government agency overseeing the civil emergency services in Russia.
activities: June 23, 2023: Flew from Khmeimim Air Base (Syria) to Bamako (Mali), likely carrying supplies and Wagner Group personnel||Prior to Mali flight, was spotted at Krasnodar airport near Molkino, a known Wagner Group training base||Has made multiple flights to Mali, often after stopovers in Damascus, Syria||Delivered humanitarian aid to Wuhan, China during the COVID-19 pandemic

description: Heavy cargo transport aircraft operated by Aviacon Zitotrans, a Russian cargo airline sanctioned by the US.
alert_content: This aircraft has been reported flying between South Africa and Goma (DRC) in May 2024, potentially transporting troops and equipment to support an offensive against the M23 rebel group.||These recent flights are not visible on this map as the owner/operator has requested that RA-76846 not be available for public tracking on FlightAware with the message: "This aircraft (RA-76846) is not available for public tracking per request from the owner/operator."
owner_info: Aviacon Zitotrans is a Russian cargo airline with the largest fleet of IL-76 heavy transport aircraft in Russia. The company has been implicated in transporting military equipment and personnel to conflict zones worldwide. The company is owned by Valery Savelyev, a businessman with reported ties to Russian political circles and alleged connections to the FSB and organized crime groups.
activities: Sanctioned by the US in 2023 for involvement in Russia's defence sector||Transported military equipment including missiles and helicopter parts globally||Delivered equipment to Venezuela, Africa, and other regions||Attempted to facilitate arms sales through intermediaries for Rosoboroneksport (Russia's state-owned defense entity)
